messages:
sasha: quick idea: make model anchors explicit immutable snapshots, plus a short-lived lease handshake so rollbacks and rehydrates are unambiguous. objections?

maria: short + sweet. can you list the minimal fields you'd want in a rollout manifest? keep it under 10 keys if possible.

sasha: minimal sketch: ```{
  "anchor": "snapshot:v2.1+sha256:abc123",
  "content_hash": "sha256:abc123",
  "lease_token": "lt-20250301-42",
  "epoch": "42",
  "fallback_order": ["quantized-8", "fp16"]
}```

alex: two operational notes: 1) lease_token must be revocable by control plane; 2) keep content_hash required only for clients that verify exact bits.

priya: plenty of clients expect semantic versions. add optional `semantic_version` so human-facing UIs aren't forced to use hashes.

sasha: yep, resolver uses anchor+lease; semantic_version is a label only.

simon: when we rehydrate same semantic_version with new content_hash, routing needs a `soft_update` behavior so cached nodes don't get surprised. lease_token alone won't cover that.

maria: agree. propose `soft_update: true|false`. if true, clients keep using cached content_hash until a probe passes. else immediate switch.

sasha: also propose `schema_version: "2025-01-01-v1"`, `compatibility_checksum` (short eval-suite fingerprint), and `immutable_anchor` flag.

alex: compatibility_checksum needs definition. small eval-suite hash? could be noisy but a quick guardrail.

priya: for migration, servers should emit both legacy lease fields and new `lease_token` for a transition window. clients should ignore unknown fields.

ops-bot: deploybot: staging manifest accepted. legacy clients will ignore `compatibility_checksum` and `soft_update`.

maria: telemetry request: please emit `manifest_applied`, `resolver_fallback_used`, `compat_check_passed`, `rehydrate_trigger` (manual/auto). we need to understand defaults.

alex: migration plan: 1) publish schema v1 and include `schema_version` in manifests; 2) server emits `legacy_lease` + `lease_token` for 30 days; 3) client shim prefers `lease_token`; 4) after 30d drop legacy field.

priya: add `deprecate_after_ts` so control plane can auto-flag soft-deprecation windows for variants.

sasha: edge-case: explicit rollback to an older content_hash under same semantic_version must be signaled. add `rollout_intent` enum: `replace|rollback`.

simon: ops checklist: routing must respect `fallback_order`, `soft_update`, and tenant-level pin overrides. document how `immutable_anchor` errors surface.

maria: question: do we want `immutable_anchor` default false? if true, registering a different content_hash under same anchor should be rejected. helps audits.

sasha: yes default false, opt-in true. also add optional `forced_rollout_ts` to schedule forced flips.

alex: sample manifest with the ideas: ```{
  "schema_version": "2025-01-01-v1",
  "anchor": "snapshot:2025-03-01:v2.1",
  "content_hash": "sha256:abc123",
  "semantic_version": "2.1",
  "lease_token": "lt-20250301-42",
  "epoch": "42",
  "soft_update": true,
  "immutable_anchor": true,
  "compatibility_checksum": "e3b0c442",
  "fallback_order": ["quantized-8", "fp16"]
}```

priya: next steps: RFC + compat-shim PR + SDK/console updates. Console needs UI for `soft_update` and `deprecate_after_ts` flags.

sasha: action items: I'll open RFC with draft + migration timeline. alex please prototype client shim. maria add telemetry hooks and console ticket. simon add ops runbook for rollback & immutable_anchor violations.

alex: on it, will push a small PR with tests.

maria: filing console ticket and linking to RFC when ready. :+1:

sasha: thanks. dropping RFC link when created.

ops-bot: note: RFC created by sasha: https://rfd.internal/2025/anchored-snapshot-lease-handshake (auto)
